database.description: Database connection settings (required for stateful deployments).

max_retries.description: Maximum database connection retry attempts. -1 = unlimited.

debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging. Disable in production unless troubleshooting.

default_store.description: Default storage backend name (must match one in 'stores').

filesystem_store_datadir.description: Local directory path for the 'file' store (only required if using file backend).

image_cache_dir.description: Directory for caching transformed images (e.g., converted formats).

image_formats.description: List of allowed image formats (for validation).

keystone_authtoken.description: Keystone authentication settings (required for production deployments).

cafile.description: Path to CA certificate bundle for TLS verification.

insecure.description: Disable TLS certificate verification. Set to false in production.

password.description: Password for the service user (sensitive—use secrets management in production).

project_name.description: Project (tenant) name for the Glance service user.

log_file.description: Path to log file. Leave empty to log to stderr or use syslog if configured.

log_level.description: Minimum log level. Options: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL.

flavor.description: Pipeline flavor. Typically 'keystone' for production with auth.

stores.description: List of image storage backends (e.g., file, swift, s3, ceph). Must include at least one store.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the store.

name.description: Store backend name (e.g., file, swift, s3, ceph, vsphere).

region.description: Region name (for cloud stores like Swift or S3).

task.description: Task processor settings (used for import/export and image conversion).

workers.description: Number of worker processes for the API service. Increase for higher concurrency.
